issue.title: test_fakey_priority_admission_differs_from_park_order flakes under the parallel check lane
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-ud.13.1.3.1.1 note 1 during the status-strip epic. On master a646bdaf6, tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py::test_fakey_priority_admission_differs_from_park_order failed under the parallel just check lane, then passed in isolation on the unchanged tree. A current focused run of the full runner-slots module also passes. Investigate whether host contention exposes a priority-admission race or whether the e2e timeout is undersized; measure under the full parallel/contention lane before changing production behavior or timeouts. This is distinct from sase-n6, which tracks the sibling child-exemption node.
